text: Ludo Lullabi is an artist who has worked with Blizzard on multiple occasions. He was most notably penciller for World of Warcraft: The Comic series. He has also worked on World of Warcraft: Ashbringer, Curse of the Worgen, and made the artwork for the Leaders of Azeroth short stories. His other works include Eternal Midnight, Kookaburra Universe, Lilian Cortez, and Lanfeust Quest. He lives in Southern France.

The Lunar Festival is a time of celebration. The people of Azeroth celebrate their triumph of many thousands of years ago, when an alliance of good races (the night elves, tauren, furbolgs, and earthen) defeated a terrible evil called the Burning Legion. It is also a time of remembrance for the valor and wisdom of that ancient age. Today, the Lunar Festival is held by the druids of Nighthaven. Both the Horde and Alliance are welcome to celebrate and shoot fireworks — a symbol of Elune's power. Ancient heroes of the past also appear throughout the land, offering gifts to those who find and honor them. It is a time of happiness, fortune and celebration, but it has a deeper motive as well
Lunar Festival Heralds are tauren quest givers located outside the banks and at the Lunar Pools in Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and Undercity during the Lunar Festival.
Luminous Pyrestone is crafted with Jewelcrafting (375); taught by Design: Luminous Pyrestone and Design: Luminous Pyrestone#Shattered Sun Offensive.
Lunar Festival Fireworks Pack is sold by Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade for during the Lunar Festival. It is also rewarded from Elune's Blessing (quest).

__NOTOC__ Lurid is a minion of Thassarian, that he raised from the corpse of a soldier of Unit S. He accompanied his master to The Wailing Ziggurat and later to Naxxanar, where he was destroyed but Thassarian raised him once more.

Lunar Festival Sentinels are elite guards only found during the Lunar Festival in Moonglade. They are always set at the maximum level of the current expansion. They attack players who attack those of the opposite faction. They will also attack those who are at war with the Cenarion Circle. More of them spawn as the fight progresses. They look like Cenarion Hold Infantry.

Lunarfall Inn is a medium garrison building that gives Alliance players access to unique quests that reward various vanity and useful items, treasure hunter missions, and the ability to recruit followers each week based on what the player is looking for. The Horde equivalent is the Frostwall Tavern.
Lupas is a gnome fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He was killed after the portal was destroyed.
Lunarfall Ravens are dread ravens located in Moonflower Valley in .

The Lunar Crucible is a plateau high above overlooking the Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar. It is the highest point accessible on foot. Between the Legion release and patch 7.1.0, the only NPC there was a ghostly night elf named Captain Placeholder, who served no purpose. Now he has been replaced with the ghosts of Kir'altius, Hargo'then and Lynel'a, who are involved in the world quest Ancient Guidance.

Luminarian was a renowned night elven "magesmith" who lived before the time of the War of the Ancients. Using his legendary arcane forge, he crafted the runeblade :Felo'melorn according to the description given by Dath'Remar Sunstrider. There are some who speculate that it was a descendant of Luminarian who reforged Felo'melorn after it was shattered by Arthas Menethil during the Third War, but this assertion has never been verified. He was also responsible for the forging of the Quel'Serrar Blades, referencing the original Quel'Serrar, twin blade of Quel'Delar.
Lunar Guards are night elf ghosts located in the Terrace of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Lunar Priestesses are night elf ghosts located at the Terrace of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Lun'alai Druids are Zandalari troll druids in moonkin and bear forms located in the Lun'alai grove in northern Zuldazar. One is present in the Hall of the High Priests during Talanji's coronation.
Lurker's Piercing Gaze drops from the Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Lurking Schemer's Band drops from elite mobs in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Lunar-Wrath Headgear drops from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.

The Lyceum is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is accessible from the Summoners' Tomb. It leads to the Iron Hall past a magically sealed door. A lyceum is a place of learning, so this is presumably where the dark irons come to hear speeches or lectures from the senators and their emperor. This room is filled with vast numbers of non-elite, low hp dwarves, linked in groups of 10 or so. These dwarves are on a fast respawn cycle, with a number of patrols wandering through the area. On the far side, the doors to the Iron Hall stand locked and unpickable. Two braziers flank the doors, each guarded by a fire elemental. Two flamekeepers are within the room at any one time, with about 8 possible

MMO-Champion is a news and forum website on World of Warcraft. It started in 2007 and was ran by [https://www.mmo-champion.com/members/2-Boubouille Boubouille]. In mid-2010, Curse acquired MMO-Champion and became part of the Curse Network. On December 12, 2018, announced that they had acquired Curse Media from which included Wowpedia, WoWDB and MMO-Champion. On June 11, 2019, MMO-Champion was acquired by Magic Find along with WoWDB.
Maaka is an elite Zandalari troll flight master found at Zim'Torga in the contested territory of Zul'Drak.

Lysta Bancroft is a Forsaken located in the War Quarter of the Undercity, standing next to Brother Malach. As per Brother Malach's instructions, she summons different captives to fight against Edward and Tyler: Male Human Captive, Female Human Captive, Captive Ghoul, Captive Zombie, and Captive Abomination. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Lysta moved there, she stands near Brother Malach.
Lyanath is the innkeeper at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp Inn in Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Lyon Mountainheart is a dwarf located in the Library in Ironforge.

Ma'haat the Indomitable is a stone lord in Deepholm. He usually stands near Therazane's throne at her right hand. She personally calls on him to fight during The Binding. He is her son, possibly her eldest. When an essence of the Black Dragonflight appeared within Neltharion's Lair, Ma'haat was sent from Deepholm to ensure it was returned to the earth. There he was confronted by Spiritwalker Ebonhorn and an adventurer, who eventually convinced Ma'haat to give them the essence.
Lynx Rush is a talented hunter ability, available at level 75.
__NOTOC__ Lyanis Moonfall is a night elf quest giver located in the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah.

Lysander's Lovindle Bracers drop from the Unethical Adventurers that appear at the entrance of a Snowblind Mesa cave with suspicious signage in Highmountain when a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.
__NOTOC__ Lyrath Moonfeather is a night elf located in Shala'nir in Val'sharah. Before succumbing to the Nightmare, he used to embody balance and harmony.
__NOTOC__ Lyrea Windfeather is a night elf located at the Moonfall Roost in Suramar.

:"Arise, fair sun, and kill my envious foes. They don't have a legendary as beautiful as you." :— Flavor text Lyra the Sunshard is a powerful elemental being native to Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone. She's "basically on the level of an Elemental Lord".
Lyris the Wild Mage is a blood elf mage featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. She is a crazed mage who is obsessed with fire magic.

MOTHER (Matron of Tenacity, Herald of Endless Research) is a titanic watcher with special responsibility for the research facility of Uldir, whose main function is to carry out experiments on Old God samples. To fulfill this role, MOTHER was imbued by the titans with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, especially any kind which might resolve the Old God threat. Eventually, Uldir itself would become compromised and contaminated through the influence of G'huun, throwing the facility into chaos. Despite the corruption, MOTHER's protocols remained intact, and she aided mortal champions in pushing through Uldir to ultimately vanquish G'huun. The Maelstrom is a massive, fierce vortex of water that was created when the Well of Eternity collapsed into itself during the Great Sundering. It is located in the middle of the Great Sea which subsequently filled the void. The water churns constantly in a dizzying storm of tidal and arcane energy that seems to have no end. The capital city of the Kaldorei Empire, Zin-Azshari, was dragged under creating Nazjatar. Ship and zeppelin routes go out of their way to avoid the Maelstrom, for fairly obvious reasons.

This article lists the races that are able to become mages, along with the lore behind each. As of patch 10.0 (Dragonflight), every playable race, with the notable exception of the dracthyr, may follow the path of the mage.

Madoran Bronzebeard was the ruling thane of Ironforge and the Bronzebeard clan before and during the War of the Three Hammers. The Bronzebeard clan, ruled by Thane Madoran Bronzebeard, held close ties to the High King and stood as the traditional defenders of Ironforge Mountain. Following the defeat of Thaurissan and the Dark Iron clan, King Bronzebeard offered the Wildhammers a place to live within the borders of Ironforge, but the Wildhammers steadfastly refused. He had the Thandol Span bridge built to maintain links with the Wildhammer clan of dwarves from the Hinterlands. After his death, his and Khardros' sons had statues built to honor both he and Khardros Wildhammer in the Valley of K
__NOTOC__ Maethrya is a night elf hippogryph flight master found behind Everlook in Winterspring.

Mael Shelub is a bitter and cruel nerubian necromancer. He despises everyone, especially the Lich King and the Scourge, and though still alive - unlike many of his kin - he prefers the company of the dead rather than the living. His hatred of the Lich King stems from his belief that undead creatures should always be under mortal control — anything else is an abomination. Mael offered his services to Blarus Whitrick, a Forsaken undead, who readily accepted. They settled in Gaval Moch, a ruined castle in Silverpine Forest, with a number of acolytes. Mael only pretended to serve Blarus however, as his beliefs concerning undead extended to the free-willed Forsaken, whose use of magical arts repe
Maddened Frosthorns are rams located in the mountains between the Grizzly Hills and the northwestern Howling Fjord. They can frequently be seen fighting each other.

Madaggan is a dragonspawn of the black flight who resides in southern Dustwallow Marsh. He wishes to see the Alliance vacate from Theramore. He willingly assists a group of Theramore deserters (ex-Kul Tiras marines) led by Rober Ronn in an assassination attempt on Jaina Proudmoore. He sends his daughter, Shalrath to assist the defectors.

Mage-Commander Evenstar is a blood elf quest giver found drowned in Lake Indu'le in the Dragonblight. He was leading an expedition of mage hunters who were later ambushed and killed by water elementals.
Mage Bomb is a passive mage ability, available at level 75. It is replaced when choosing Frost Bomb, Living Bomb, or Nether Tempest.
Madison is a human child located at Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. She can be found wandering the path from the fields behind Alma Jainrose's shop to the docks.
Madam Vee Luo is a pandaren innkeeper, serving in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons.
Macabre Maraca is an ability used by Macabre Marionette during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Maelgwyn is a worgen fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.
Mag'har Refugees are Mag'har orcs located in Shattrath City.

The madcaps of the Zandalar tribe are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness, chaos, and the unpredictability of existence. A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst the Zandalari's enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. The tribe would not exist today without them. One of Zandalar's legendary madcaps was Khar'vaxal the Cracked. Legend states that when facing the enemies of the tribe for the first time, Khar'vaxal used his mantle specifically woven with "the weave of madness". The Machine of Origination is a massive device created by the mysterious First Ones and interred within their Sepulcher in the realm of Zereth Mortis in the Shadowlands. The Jailer Zovaal reactivated it using the world-soul of Azeroth as a power source and attempted to remake reality into one that served him, so it could stand against what he saw as a coming threat. However the Maw Walkers from Azeroth were able to defeat the Jailer on the verge of his great victory, shutting down the Machine of Origination once again. Magma Totem is an Enhancement shaman totem ability. It causes AoE fire damage. It is one of the Shaman's two AoE attacks, doing it as a DoT instead of a single burst.

Mageroyal is an herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (50), or bought in limited quantities from selected vendors. Mageroyal seems to be edible, as it is used in the recipe for Delicious Chocolate Cake. It is also mentioned in The Worst Mage in Dalaran: A Children's Book, where it is described as "glistening". The last paragraph of this work would seem to imply that mageroyal grows where magical activity has recently occurred, though obviously in the game it spawns in preset nodes. Forest Moths prefer to feed on Mageroyal nectar.
Maginor Dumas is a human quest giver and a senior mage trainer known to be one of Stormwind's most renowned mages. He is located in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter within Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Maggots are critters that can be found in the Ashenvale, Ghostlands, Hillsbrad Foothills, the Hinterlands, Howling Fjord, Naxxramas and the Undercity.
Maggran Earthbinder is a tauren quest giver and leader of Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He once fell prey to Besseleth but escaped. He has been missing since the Cataclysm.

Astalor Bloodsworn is a powerful magister who was once an advisor to Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider, and became a co-founder of the Blood Knight Order along with his superior, Grand Magister Rommath. A magical net is a type of net that shrinks, compressing the limbs close to the body. Soldiers used these on uncooperative gladiators.

Magmawyrms are a type of skeleton dragon raised from the corpses of black wyrms by the Scourge to serve as powerful minions, as seen in The Best of Intentions and Neltharion's Flame (quest). They appear similar to the emberwyrms, former red wyrms. Nightbane in Karazhan may be a type of magmawyrm, although he was raised from the blue dragon Arcanagos.

Magmashell is obtained through the use of Empty Magma Shell in the Waking Shores. Loot the shell from lava snails in the vicinity of south of the Obsidian Citadel, then head to east of Scalecracker Keep. An Empowered Snail is way down in the lava, so the goal is to swim into the lava and channel a 16-second Embiggening Snail cast on it. As swimming in lava... hurts, just a bit... and players are busy channeling the spell, another healer will need to be on-hand to keep the channeling player alive.
Magically Vintaged Wine is located near Zinfandormu at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Magma slugs or lava slugs are a type of slug added with the Dragonflight expansion. They are similar to magma snails.

Magically Bound Message is automatically received after reaching Renown 7 with the Dragonscale Expedition. It starts Dormant Discovery.
The Magocrats (also referred as Magocrat lords and Magocrat Lords of Arathor) were the ruling archmagi of the city-state of Dalaran.

Mahu is a tauren leatherworking and tailoring vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.

Magus Filinthus is grumpy old Alliance mage present in the Alchemist's Tower in Honor Hold. After a while, he will leave the tower and walk to the keep where Force Commander Danath Trollbane has summoned him. He seems very displeased with the way practically everything has changed since the Dark Portal has reopened, although he does show respect for the decisions of his superiors... at least while they are within earshot. Sometimes he will walk to the Honor Hold inn, order Sid Limbardi to deliver some ale to his tower and teleport out.

Mahala Cloudsong is a tauren shaman trainer of the Cloudsong tribe; she can be found alongside Mala Skywatcher in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. She's been the second Horde shaman trainer in the to be added in the Eastern Kingdoms, the first being Haromm in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Mai of the Wall is a pandaren flight master with the Shado-Pan found on the Serpent's Spine in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Magnify... Enhance is an achievement awarded by defeating the Empowered Construct in Skyreach on Heroic difficulty.

She also appears at Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore during Call of the Marksman. She gave Vereesa Windrunner a portal stone and opened a Portal to Niskara. As Vereesa entered the portal, Sol felt fel magic eating at her soul.
The Majestic Elderhorn Hoof drops from the Majestic Elderhorn in Highmountain.
Magolith is a doomguard located in the Vault of the Wardens. He can be briefly seen during the demon hunter starting experience, fighting Malace Shade.
Magus Bonechill is a Forsaken located in either Stormheim, Val'sharah or Highmountain.

These crustaceans live in colonies along the shores of Azeroth and in the deeper oceans. The Makers' Perch, is a titan facility constructed as a vantage point where they oversaw their creations. The perch is located in northwest Sholazar Basin and is home to several titan constructs that continue to guard the empty halls. Compared to the Makers' Overlook, Makers' Perch is a lesser place. Its entrance is cut into the mountain wall, but it rests on the floor of the basin. The relatively short hall within ends in large, arched observation windows that look out into the sea. According to Brann Bronzebeard, a gnome took a submarine out to this area of the sea, and she didn't find these windows.
Makki Wintergale is a taunka flight master located at Camp Oneqwah in the Grizzly Hills.

Malevolent Fury is a sha in Firebough Nook of Kun-Lai Summit who corrupted the yaungol leader Kobai through a magical mask. Makaanji is the flight master for the Scorched Sands Outpost in Vol'dun.

Making the Mount is an achievement that is earned by completing the questline to build the Scrapforged Mechaspider. It can be started after unlocking daily quests for the Rustbolt Resistance by completing Welcome to the Resistance, and begins with Recycler Kerchunk on Mechagon Island.
Malachi Moneybolt is a goblin located Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.

Relentless, warlike souls who never yield and are willing to strive against one another for greatness are welcomed here by the necrolords, and the greatest of them are reformed by necromancers into undead soldiers who defend the Shadowlands from external forces and wage war on the enemies of death. Mammoths are large, shaggy beasts found in Northrend and on the Dragon Isles that resemble behemoths or elekk. They can be found in the Borean Tundra, the Dragonblight, Sholazar Basin, and Zul'Drak in Northrend, and the Azure Span and Ohn'ahran Plains on the Dragon Isles. However, they are frequently hunted and slain by poachers, the most notable of which is Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer, a member of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting party. They are used as mounts by the frost giants of the Sons of Hodir.
Malown's Slam is a Level 45 quality Two-Handed Mace with a Chance on hit to Stun and temporarily increase Strength.

Malevus the Mad is a blood elf. She is one of the random prisoners that is trapped in a Ethereum Prison and drops an Ethereum Prisoner I.D. Tag. She is the weakest hostile being that you can encounter from opening an Ethereum Prison, having the least health and no abilities. She is immune to stun. She is wearing the Blessed Battlegear of Undead Slaying.
Malfurion's Gift is a passive specialization ability for Restoration druids, available at level 10. It reduces the cooldown of Tranquility.

Malfurion's Breach is the entrance point from where the Guardians of Hyjal invade the Firelands in the area known as the Molten Front. It's here, after securing the area, that Malfurion Stormrage plants a seed that would grow into massive tree, known as a Sentinel Tree, that will shelter them and allow them to hold their ground. Once grown this outpost will serve as a permanent shelter for the druids that will be maintained here to watch over the realm, making sure that events like that happening now will not happen again. Malfurion's Tenacity is a level 100 druid talent, added in Warlords of Draenor. It is granted to Guardian druids choosing Will of Malfurion.

Malificus is a nathrezim world boss at Wrynnfall on the Broken Shore, before the Tomb of Sargeras. During The Battle for Broken Shore (quest) he is seen mind controlling Argent Dawnbringers to his bidding in the Black City.

Reign of Chaos= |-| The Frozen Throne= Furion was the first night elf to oppose the evil Queen Azshara and her demon-worshiping high-borne. He, along with his brother Illidan and the demi-god Cenarius, led the battle against the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. He was the first to forsake magic and adopt the tenets of druidism. He has been the spiritual leader of the night elves for over ten thousand years and has worked to safeguard his people's fragile culture – even from within the trance-like state of the Emerald Dream.

The Malfunctioning Golem is a Zandalari golem that runs erratically around a shallow pool of water in the eastern part of the Bone Pit in Vol'dun. When it is destroyed, a group of Released Spirits emerge from it.

Malfunctioning Microbots are alarm-o-bots, spraybots, and microbots located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. It can appear with three different models, the regular alarm-o-bot, the Mechagon version, and the spraybot version.

Malformed Creations are oozes located in the Gallery of Failures in Uldir. They periodically assume one of three animal forms—Malformed Lions, Malformed Raptors, and Malformed Vultures—each with different abilities. The transformation lasts until the Creation runs out of energy, which depletes from 100 at a rate of 4 per second, giving each form an effective duration of 25 seconds. When the transformation expires, the Creation immediately starts assuming its next form. __NOTOC__

Malygos's Lingering Essence is found at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus. Originally contained in the :Heart of Magic, the essence was released at the Veiled Ossuary by Kalecgos. It was, however, unstable and caused violent arcane memories to flood the ossuary. It was then relocated to the Azure Archives in the Azure Span by Azuregos and his fellow dragons. Kalec, Sindragosa's simulacrum, and many of the blue dragons released the essence inside the Azure Vault, forming the Remnants of Malygos. After the remnants are defeated and soothed, the essence transformed into Malygos's Calmed Essence, after which Malygos's ghost was properly sent to the other side.
Mana Tide Totem is a Restoration shaman totem that increases the mana regeneration of party and raid members within 10 yards by 100%.

Mana Surges are mana surges found in Dustwallow Marsh during the Mana Surges. It is the basic type of mana surge. It pours out of rifts opened by arcane magic. A Mage will need to defeat 12 of them in 10 minutes during the quest Mana Surges.
Mani Winterhoof is a tauren alchemy vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
Manastorm Leggings are a nice piece of cloth leggings for a healer looking for mana regeneration gear.

Mana Agates are soulbound items that, when used, regenerate a portion of the user's mana. They are created by Conjure Mana Agate.

The Marapor cultists are a demon cult which resides along the coast region of Desolace. They have a brand in the shape of a six-sided star hidden under the hair on their scalp.

Mannoroth's Bones was the Horde flagship sent to from Ratchet to Borean Tundra to bring the last of the Horde troops home after the War with the Lich King. Cairne Bloodhoof was aboard the ship to supervise the evacuation operations. As the last of the supplies and veterans from Warsong Hold were being loaded, a group of kvaldir landed and attacked the Horde forces at Garrosh Landing. Between the leadership of Cairne and Garrosh they were able to get the injured to the damaged ship and escape to sea.
